title.value: Environmental and Social Sustainability of Creative-Ai
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the header of the paper.
title.quote: Environmental and Social Sustainability of Creative-Ai

extractions.description: The paper investigates the sustainability and ethical aspects of using Creative-AI in artistic processes. It examines environmental sustainability in AI arts and ethical issues concerning power, authorship, and ownership in the creative process, using interdisciplinary approaches combining various research methods. The research aims to develop ethical guidelines and sustainable practices for integrating AI in art creation.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on understanding the environmental sustainability aspects of Creative-AI as well as proposes interdisciplinary methods to address these issues, indicating that sustainable development is a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We investigate such Creative-Ai from sustainability and ethical perspectives. The two main focus areas are understanding the environmental sustainability aspects...

primary_category.justification: The paper mainly investigates the environmental impact of AI technologies used in Creative-AI practices, which falls under the Pollution category due to the focus on environmental impact and CO2 emissions.
primary_category.quote: Our main research directions related to environmental sustainability are to analyze the environmental impact of various Creative-Ai technologies and practices...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper discusses the use of emerging financial technologies like blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and NFTs in the context of AI art, highlighting the need for sustainable financial practices.
secondary_categories.quote: Sustainability issues are also related to the commercialization of Ai art. These include, for example, the use of emerging technologies such as blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and Non-fungible tokens (NFTs)...

primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on quantifying the energy impact and CO2 emissions from AI technologies aligns with the Air Pollution sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...energy use and CO2 emissions being analyzed by [2]–[5]...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Addressing the sustainability of financial models and commercialization methods like NFTs and cryptocurrencies in AI arts points to the climate finance sub-category.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: ...Ai art(s) shape new markets, which have the potential to introduce an additional environmental footprint through energy-heavy blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and NFT technologies.

applications.value: Quantifying energy usage and CO2 emissions
applications.justification: The research included measuring energy usage of Creative-AI technologies to understand and address their environmental impact.
applications.quote: We have measured energy usage in different kinds of running environments for VQGAN+Clip...and provided initial figures for these measurements...

new_primary_category.justification: Existing categories sufficiently describe the themes covered in the paper.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: Existing sub-categories sufficiently describe the themes covered in the paper.
